name: My Charming Butlers
source: Your uneventful city life is taking its toll—until a chance encounter leaves you as the proprietress of Calico Manor. Within this historic building are centuries of untold secrets waiting to be discovered, along with a trio of butlers sworn to help you… Although it doesn't take long to realize the true mystery lies within your heart...
translation: 平静的城市生活让你付出了代价——直到一次偶然的邂逅让你成为了卡利科庄园的女主人。在这座历史悠久的建筑中，有几个世纪的不为人知的秘密等待着你去发现，还有三位管家发誓为你提供帮助……尽管你很快就会意识到真正的秘密就藏在你的心中……
